message:
I can see the stack-buffer-overflow WRITE clearly now. In `latm_dmx_process`:

```c
u8 latm_buffer[4096];
u32 latm_frame_size = 4096;
if (!latm_dmx_sync_frame_bs(ctx->bs,&ctx->acfg, &latm_frame_size, latm_buffer, NULL)) break;
```

And in `latm_dmx_sync_frame_bs`:
```c
if (buffer) {
    gf_bs_read_data(bs, (char *) buffer, size);
}
```

If `size` (which is `latm_frame_size`) is larger than 4096, `gf_bs_read_data` writes past the stack buffer. This is the stack-buffer-overflow WRITE.
